title: Integer-unit compatibility of the scalar-forgetful comparison
statement: With δ from [new-sc-scalar-forget-pullback-comparison-isIso], the integer-unit morphism on Y followed by U_Y of the inverse scalar unit isomorphism equals the inverse constant-integer pullback isomorphism followed by L_ab of the integer-unit morphism on X and δ at the scalar tensor unit.

source.place: Tags 0096 (lemma-pullback-pushforward-adjoint) and 01F7 (cohomology-equation-functorial); specialization to the explicit Lean constructions

proof.text: Apply the constant-integer adjunction and evaluate at the generator 1; this is injective. On the left naturality gives the inverse scalar unit map applied to the section one. On the right the uniqueness identity for constant-sheaf pullback changes the adjunction to the composite adjunction. Naturality and the adjunct formula for δ give the scalar inverse-image unit applied to the section one. These sections agree: unfold scalarInverseUnitIso, use the uniqueness identity for scalar constant-sheaf pullback, and naturality of the scalar inverse-image unit. No nonemptiness or characteristic hypothesis enters.

theorem scalarForgetPullbackComparison_integerUnit (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (a : Y ⟶ X) :
    let L := (Opens.map a.base).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
    Abelian.Ext.homEquiv₀ (scalarAbelianUnitClass k Y) ≫
        (scalarAbelianForget k Y).map (scalarInverseUnitIso a).inv =
      (((Opens.map a.base).constantSheafsheafPullbackIso AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
        isTerminalTop isTerminalTop).symm.app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))).hom ≫
      L.map (Abelian.Ext.homEquiv₀ (scalarAbelianUnitClass k X)) ≫
        (scalarForgetPullbackComparison k a).app (𝟙_ (KSheaf X k))
